scenes.title: Introduction and Definition of Biology
scenes.text: Etymological origins from Greek bios (life) and logos (study). Biology as the empirical natural science investigating living organisms, their structure, function, and vital processes.

scenes.title: Universal Characteristics of Living Organisms
scenes.text: Cellular organization, metabolism (anabolism vs catabolism), and homeostasis. Living things maintain steady internal states and convert energy.

scenes.title: Growth, Reproduction, and Genetic Transmission
scenes.text: Irreversible biological growth, asexual vs sexual reproduction, DNA hereditary transmission, and evolutionary adaptation in populations.

scenes.title: Borderline Entities: Viruses, Viroids, and Prions
scenes.text: Virions as non-cellular macromolecular complexes. Obligate intracellular parasites with no independent metabolism outside hosts.

scenes.title: Hierarchical Levels of Biological Organization
scenes.text: Ascending biological hierarchy: Subatomic, atoms (CHNOPS), molecules, organelles, cells, tissues, organs, ecosystems, biosphere. Emergent properties.

scenes.title: Major Branches and Sub-disciplines of Biology
scenes.text: Structural (cytology, histology, anatomy, physiology), taxonomic (botany, zoology, microbiology), and integrative fields (genetics, ecology, biotechnology).

scenes.title: The Scientific Method in Biological Investigations
scenes.text: Systematic inquiry: Observation, question, falsifiable hypothesis, controlled experiments, independent/dependent/controlled variables, conclusion.

scenes.title: Added Gap 1: Endemic Afroalpine Wildlife Conservation
scenes.text: Walia ibex in Semien Mountains, Ethiopian wolf in Bale Mountains, Gelada baboon in Menz. High-altitude hypoxia adaptation, population bottlenecks, in situ conservation.

scenes.title: Added Gap 2: Crop Wild Relatives & Vavilov Center
scenes.text: Nikolai Vavilov's 8 diversity centers. Teff (Eragrostis tef), Coffee Arabica wild cloud forest alleles, Enset fermentation (Kocho), and EBI gene bank.

scenes.title: Added Gap 3: Experimental Design & Laboratory Bio-Safety
scenes.text: Compound light microscope optics, total magnification formula, PPE safety, international biohazard symbols, and autoclaving waste disposal.

scenes.title: Section Summary & Ethiopian Biodiversity Heritage
scenes.text: Synthesis of core biological concepts, living criteria, and practical applications for Ethiopian development and conservation.
